market_name: Will 5 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether 2026 SOFR/Fed-funds futures confirm a dovish repricing alongside the prediction-market move; if futures are flat, treat the signal as noise.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT move to 2y/10y yield change; confirm direction consistency and whether any Fed speak or data triggered it.
time_plan.2h: Reassess whether the move persists or mean-reverts; look for an obvious public catalyst (CPI, jobs, Fed headline) that would make this already-public.
time_plan.6h: Evaluate curve steepening/flattening and whether equity and FX proxies agree with the dovish read.
time_plan.12h: Mark final TLT return vs. prediction; log whether the prediction-market move led, lagged, or merely tracked rates futures.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability of 5 Fed cuts in 2026 reflects a dovish repricing of the rate path. More cuts means lower expected front-end and belly yields; duration-heavy Treasuries rally as the discounted policy path falls. TLT is the most direct, liquid proxy for a dovish Fed-expectations shift. However, this market is a 2026 rate-path question, so most signal is already embedded in the OIS/futures curve that bonds track; a prediction-market move alone is unlikely to move TLT more than tens of bps in 12h, far below the 700bp tradable threshold.

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm DXY/EURUSD direction aligns with the dovish signal and is not driven by a foreign-central-bank story.
time_plan.1h: Check whether rate-differential moves (US 2y vs Bund/JGB) support dollar weakness.
time_plan.2h: Reassess persistence and whether a US data surprise is the real driver (already public).
time_plan.6h: Evaluate whether gold/EM FX corroborate a broad dollar-down theme.
time_plan.12h: Mark final UUP return and log lead/lag vs. rates and the prediction market.

predictions.reasoning: More expected Fed cuts narrows US rate differentials versus other G10 currencies, typically pressuring the dollar lower. A dovish repricing of 2026 cut expectations should weigh modestly on UUP. The link is real but indirect and small over 12h, well under the 700bp threshold; FX also responds to relative (not just US) policy expectations, weakening the mapping.

evidence_used: Market resolves on cumulative number of 25bp FOMC cuts in 2026; higher implied prob of 5 cuts = more dovish path
Standard transmission: dovish Fed-path repricing lifts Treasuries, pressures USD, supports gold/rate-sensitive equities
2026 rate-path expectations are already heavily priced into liquid OIS/SOFR futures that bonds and FX track
uncertainty_notes: Mislabeled primary topic ('military_conflict') is irrelevant; this is a pure monetary-policy market
12h window magnitudes for macro ETFs are typically tens of bps, far below the 700bp tradable bar
Prediction-market odds on a year-long rate count likely lag, not lead, futures-implied pricing

llm_justification.summary: This is a 2026 Fed rate-cut-count market. A sharp increase in the probability of 5 cuts is a dovish signal, implying lower yields (TLT up) and a softer dollar (UUP down), with gold and rate-sensitive equities as secondary beneficiaries. But the 2026 path is already priced into liquid rates futures, so a prediction-market move alone should produce only modest, sub-threshold 12h moves. Directionally plausible, magnitude small, confidence moderate-to-low.
key_assumptions: A rise in implied probability of 5 cuts is genuinely dovish and not driven by a growth-shock scare that also hits risk assets
Treasuries and the dollar respond to US rate-path expectations in the usual direction
No overwhelming offsetting foreign-central-bank or risk-sentiment driver during the window
failure_modes: The dovish signal stems from recession fear — bonds rally but equities fall, breaking the simple risk-on read
The information is already fully public and embedded in futures, so TLT/UUP do not move incrementally
Prediction-market move is noise/low-liquidity and reverses within hours
Proxies are weakly exposed: a 2026-path shift barely moves a long-duration ETF over 12h
Move never approaches the 700bp tradable threshold, so no actionable signal
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
